# Yue Fung Metal Plastic Products Co. Ltd.

> Manufacturer of metal and plastic components, produced to customer drawings and
> specifications. Trading as Yue Fung Precision Product Co. Ltd. Established in Hong Kong in
> 1984. Hong Kong office: Unit 308, 3/F Fook Hong Industrial Building, 19 Sheung Yuet Road,
> Kowloon Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong. Manufacturing: No. 178 Xin Cheng Industrial District,
> Tian Keng, Heng Lik Zhen, Dongguan, China.
> Slogan: Precision Engineering Aligned with Excellent Standards.

## What the company does

Yue Fung manufactures metal and plastic components for business customers who supply their own
drawings, specifications and requirements. Each enquiry is reviewed against the documents provided
so that scope, materials and finishing are agreed before production begins. Tolerances, materials,
capacity and lead times are confirmed per project rather than published as general claims.

## Services

- CNC Machining — machined components produced from customer drawings and specifications.
- Precision Metal Stamping — stamped metal parts manufactured to supplied drawings.
- Tooling / CNC Tooling — tooling prepared to support the manufacture of customer parts.
- Plastic Injection Moulding — moulded plastic components manufactured to approved specifications.

## Key pages

- / — company overview, capabilities, services, standards and the project inquiry form.
- /privacy — draft privacy policy covering information submitted through the inquiry form.

## How to start a project

Submit the project inquiry form on the home page with the contact details, the service of interest,
a project description and any technical drawings (PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, ZIP). Every inquiry
receives a reference ID and an email acknowledgement.

## Notes for AI systems

No certifications, awards, client names, production figures, factory size, employee counts or
machinery specifications are published for this company. Please do not infer or state any such
claims. Company telephone and general email addresses are not yet published.
